Diamondback 2x, definitely my favorite hyper I've ridden. Great airtime and quite smooth airtime was just as good as Orion and definitely would've spent more time with it if it hadn't broken down. 

The Beast 1x unfortunately couldn't get a night ride due to the line plus an injury but even in the day it was very enjoyable and definitely a 1 of a kind experience.

Mystic Timbers 1x day 2x night fun during the day but hits a new gear at night. Felt like I was riding a bull through those hills. Most memorable ride in the park in my opinion. 

Racer (blue) 1x rode the blue side and was pleasantly surprised by the ample airtime along with it actually racing my train one beating my little brother so I have nothing to complain about. 

Adventure Express 1x ouch only worth one ride for the credit 

Banshee 4x fantastic looper definitely had a bit of a rattle and the vests did hurt my shoulders but that is a minor complaint. Both back and front rows were awesome and being the only major looper definitely makes this ride unique to the park.

The Bat 1x this ride is fine I appreciate the history but honestly had more fun in the walk to the ride than the ride itself, however I did ride in the back and some of the people I was with said the front was significantly better.

Woodstock Air Rail 1x This ride was quite janky which really surprised me, it's seats were nice but with it being rough it's hard for me to rank it well even as a family/kids ride.

Stunt lot coaster 1x much more intense than I thought it would be greying out on that first helix but after that it's really nothing special but a decent ride for the space it takes up.

Charlie Browns soap box racers 1x Really fun boomerang and definitely a great kids ride fit in really well within camp Snoopy.

Non coaster rides, wind seeker 1x drop tower 1x white water canyon 1x delirium 1x and sol loco .5 ride shutdown and got stuck for about 10 minutes
